# Doit Then 1.0.9
- Fixed recurring Reminders sometimes leaving an extra future occurrence after Undo or restoring from Calendar. - Improved Reminder and Calendar reliability during rapid refreshes, failed saves, and Undo/Redo. - Duplicate now preserves Reminder details, and Quick Add keeps your draft if saving fails. - Fixed cross-day scheduling conflict detection and unscheduling alert cleanup. - Fixed task context-menu actions and removed obsolete scheduling and debug code.
